capabilities: Toggle a fullscreen distraction-free zen mode with a hotkey
Hide the properties area while writing
Switch between single-pane and dual-pane comparison modes
Style tabs as floating edge text with fixed or split positions
Prevent Esc from exiting zen mode
extras: README is bilingual (Chinese and English); the plugin had not yet been listed in the community marketplace, so installation currently relies on manual file placement or pending review.
problem: Obsidian's normal editing view shows tabs, properties and UI chrome that distract from focused writing.
summary: Zen-mode plugin that toggles a distraction-free fullscreen writing environment with hidden properties, floating tabs and a dual-pane mode.
